items.text:
Ostranauts is a buggy, unbalanced mess that kills your characters for no reason.

Its also possibly the most interesting RPG format game I've played in years, trying to get procedural story generation, lifepath character generation in CV format, a 'physics' based universe, sims style character needs (for multiple characters), a cash-hungry management sim and loans system, crime and enforcement and bribery, friends and enemies, trucker-style shipping, and random events to all work.

Its scope is very, very ambitious, and the decision to deliver each system in a prototype form, prioritising gameplay over 'balance' or 'polish' is really fun. Reccomend.
items.text_zh:
《Ostranauts》是一个充满bug、不平衡的烂摊子，会无缘无故地弄死你的角色。

它也可能是我多年来玩过的最有趣的RPG形式游戏，试图让程序化故事生成、简历格式的人生轨迹角色生成、基于“物理”的宇宙、模拟人生风格的角色需求（针对多个角色）、渴望现金的管理模拟和贷款系统、犯罪与执法以及贿赂、朋友与敌人、卡车司机式的运输，以及随机事件全部运作起来。

它的野心非常、非常大，而选择以原型形式交付每个系统、优先考虑玩法而非“平衡”或“打磨”的决定真的很有趣。推荐。
